## DIARRHEA WITH GIARDIA
Treatment can be offered when the patient has symptomatic disease.
Treatment of asymptomatic patients can be considered if they have contact with
immunocompromised or pregnant people or live or work in settings where there is
risk of spreading infection to others (e.g., food handlers, daycare, nursing
home).
## Primary treatment
## Inpatient Hydration and electrolyte replacement
## Antimicrobial treatment
